mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perm FROM sys_user_role ur LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.type IN ('M', 'B') AND m.`status` = 0 AND m.del_flag = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.create_time, m.parent_id, m.name, m.type, m.path, m.route_path, m.route_name, m.redirect, m.component, m.icon, m.status, m.visible, IFNULL(m.perm,'') AS perm, m.params_json FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.`status` = 0 AND m.visible = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.create_time, m.parent_id, m.name, m.type, m.path, m.route_path, m.route_name, m.redirect, m.component, m.icon, m.status, m.visible, IFNULL(m.perm,'') AS perm, m.params_json FROM sys_user_role ur LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.`status` = 0 AND m.visible = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort
